title: MY MOTH WINGS STOPPED A GRIFFIN.
summary: At the Sky Festival, a boy with hand-sized moth wings steps between a frightened first-year and the duke’s griffin-winged son.
frame_0: Winged children hurry across the sunlit Marketford square under the guildhall clock and festival pennants.
package_differences: Clean edition delivered first at Jake’s request. The sponsor edition awaits its own ending line.
ending: The final display sample cuts to black on the clipped s sound.
